preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the number of friends N must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] < i for i in range(1, N + 1))
preconditions.description: Each A[i] must be a valid index such that 0 <= A[i] < i for all i from 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the total number of steps required for each test case.
